reden: Yes. The audit report includes “[Medium] ERC20Airdrop2.withdraw reverts after the vesting window, forfeiting unwithdrawn tokens,” which is the same issue as [H-03]. Both describe ERC20Airdrop2.sol’s withdraw() being blocked after claimEnd + withdrawalWindow due to the ongoingWithdrawals modifier using a strict ‘<’ check, making fully unlocked amounts practically unclaimable unless timed exactly. Same file/function, same root cause, same impact, and would be fixed by relaxing the modifier (e.g., allowing post-window withdrawals/buffer).
